csv_project_name: CMAR for New Operations Building D
csv_scope_of_work: The CMAR Contract will include preconstruction services and procurement services seeking qualified construction subcontractors for specified Work packages. The scope of the Work will include designing and constructing new Operations Building D for the Owner to be used as a shop area with office. Construction of a high-performance Pre-Engineered Metal Building (PEMB) 168 ft by 80 ft at the Mustang SUD headquarters. The facility to be engineered to bridge industrial-scale functionality with high-efficiency conditioned spaces in full compliance with 2021 IECC (Climate Zone 3) energy standards. Building to be durable 26-gauge PBR metal enclosure including drive-through bays and semi-heated shop space. Bay areas are to be included for four general mechanical bays, two painting bays, spaces for tires, parts, and fabrication. Bay areas will include overhead doors. A large enclosed covered area is also included. A conditioned pod for office space and locker rooms (30 ft by 80 ft) will be thermally isolated. Further details on plumbing, fixtures, HVAD, and other building requirements are included in the preliminary drawings included in the 10% Technical Memorandum. Work also includes site civil, electrical, and related work.
